title: The Letter of the Marlowe Estate
author: Xanthe Quintana
blurb: Ada Blackwood, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
